definitions.full: H2854. chathullah [ חֲתֻלָּה ] noun feminine swaddling-band (see Ba NB 146 ) — only חֲתֻלֶּתוֺ וַעֲרָפֶל לְבֻשׁוֺ עָנָן בְּשׂוּמִי Job 38:9 when I made cloud its garment, and thick darkness its swaddling-band , figurative of dark clouds enveloping the sea.
